$$
(x-a)^{2}+(y-b)^{2}={r}^{2}.
$$

From the picture, we see that our circle is centered at $C(1,5)$ and the radius of the circle is $r=\frac{9}{2}.$ Therefore, the equation of the circle is

$$
\begin{aligned}(x-a)^{2}+(y-b)^{2} & ={r}^{2} \\ (x-1)^{2}+(y-5)^{2} & =(\frac{9}{2})^{2} \\ (x-1)^{2}+(y-5)^{2} & =\frac{81}{4}.\end{aligned}
